correctness.rationale: The proof completely reconstructs nonempty 01/A/B tokens from every residual, establishes that at most one whole block can be deleted, then counts central-gap insertions by weak compositions. All n>=k-1, a,b>=1 and k>=3 including singleton boundaries are covered. Two standalone independent encodings passed 447 direct positional cases and 286 full-fiber token comparisons.

originality.rationale: Three relevant indexed exact formulas and a full primary preprint were inspected and compared by scientific implication. Neither the alternating-pattern binomial-tail law, the length-two run-pair identity, nor the unrestricted deleted-composition enumeration implies the all-length, split-invariant multiplicity histogram for deleting a fixed length-at-least-three two-run pattern. A general finite algorithm does not give the all-parameter theorem. No equivalent claim was located; an unindexed equivalence remains possible.
residual_risks: A mathematically equivalent result could exist under earlier shuffle, deletion channel, or binomial-language terminology not indexed by searched titles and phrases.
Priority has not been independently assessed; the classical 2004 paper was compared by exposed scope rather than full-text proof.

value.rationale: An exact natural reconstruction and collision statistic is classified for all lengths and all positive two-run splits of a fixed deletion-pattern length. The non-obvious split invariance of the entire multiplicity spectrum gives structure beyond the residual total and supplies closed formulas where prior generic procedures required explicit enumeration.
